prompt:
Subject:
Sunset waves and white lace hem

Main Body:
A single woman sitting on a seaside embankment in the center of the screen. Wearing a white translucent lace camisole dress, she extends both legs forward and looks into the camera with the setting sun and shimmering water surface behind her to the right.

Person/Expression:
The face is slightly tilted from the front to the left of the screen, looking gently at the camera with the lips slightly parted. Rounded oval face with a small chin, long eyes and thin eyebrows, short neat tip of the nose, pale coral lips, and light pink cheeks. Dark brown bob just below the jaw, with a center-ish part and sheer bangs, hair ends slightly bouncing outward.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory white thin lace camisole dress. Features thin shoulder straps, wide lace at the deep V-neckline, switching under the bust, a sheer wide hem, and scalloped lace edges. The left hand is placed on the embankment beside the body for support, the left knee is bent high, and the right leg is extended long toward the bottom right foreground.

Background/Light:
A rough embankment continuing from the foreground to the left background, the sea and wave-dissipating blocks on the right of the screen, a low setting sun in the upper right, and the silhouettes of dark trees in the left background. Soft backlighting shines from the sunset at the rear right of the screen, illuminating the edges of the hair, shoulders, legs, and white fabric in orange.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical, full-body portrait at a camera eye level slightly lower than the seated person. The face is in the center of the upper half, the bent knee is large in the center foreground, and the extended right leg is cut at the bottom right edge. Focus on the face and upper body, with the sunset view and the back of the embankment smoothly blurred by shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
A photorealistic live-action photo of a warm sunset. Depicts translucent lace, skin, rough concrete, and water surface reflections with soft gold and low contrast.

Negative:
Do not make the front leg small; Do not omit the sheer hem of the white lace.

promptZh:
主体：
日落波光与白色蕾丝裙摆

主体描述：
画面中心是一位坐在海边堤岸上的女性。她身穿白色半透明蕾丝吊带裙，双腿向前伸展，注视着镜头，背景右侧是落日和波光粼粼的海面。

人物/表情：
脸部从正面略微向画面左侧倾斜，嘴唇微张，温柔地注视着镜头。圆润的鹅蛋脸，下巴小巧，细长的眼睛和纤细的眉毛，鼻尖小巧精致，珊瑚粉色的嘴唇，脸颊透着淡淡的粉色。下颌线以下的深棕色波波头，中分偏分，带有轻薄的刘海，发梢微微向外翘起。

服装/姿势：
象牙白薄款蕾丝吊带裙。采用细肩带设计，深 V 领口处有宽蕾丝装饰，胸下有拼接设计，裙摆宽大且呈半透明状，边缘带有扇形蕾丝花边。左手撑在身侧的堤岸上以保持平衡，左膝高高弯曲，右腿向右下方的近景处伸展。

背景/光影：
从近景延伸至左后方的粗糙堤岸，画面右侧是海面和消波块，右上角是低垂的落日，左后方有深色树木的剪影。柔和的逆光从画面右后方的日落处照射过来，将头发边缘、肩膀、腿部和白色织物勾勒出橙色的轮廓。

构图/摄影：
3:4 竖构图，全身人像，相机视线略低于坐姿人物。脸部位于上半部分的中心，弯曲的膝盖在画面中心近景处显得较大，伸展的右腿在右下边缘处截断。焦点集中在脸部和上半身，日落景色和堤岸背景通过浅景深效果平滑虚化。

质感/风格：
温暖日落下的写实风格照片。细腻刻画了半透明蕾丝、皮肤纹理、粗糙混凝土和水面反射，色调柔和金黄，对比度较低。

负面提示词：
不要把前方的腿画小；不要遗漏白色蕾丝的半透明裙摆。
